scope: All 87 ACTIVE Azure vm/nsg checks in the captured CSV cohort, independently native ARM response -> actual collector -> engine. Local runtime changes are limited to four specifically authorized defect fixes; no canonical CSV, generated metadata, frozen fixtures, signed historical source or release change.

official_api_sources.contract: Selected VM full GET, expand=instanceView, native id/type, storage/os/network/security profiles.
GET NSG custom/default rules, priority, augmented prefixes/port arrays, associations.
GET exact VM GuestConfiguration assignment children; native compliance summary and configuration parameters/version.
First matching lower-number priority and six default rules; destination-based default Internet egress Allow.
Native enabled flag is separate from existing flow-log resource/target reference.
AzurePolicyforLinux/Windows instance names and publisher/type; autoUpgradeMinorVersion vs enableAutomaticUpgrade are distinct.
Extension version upgrade properties do not establish antimalware signature freshness.
IaaSAntimalware is unsupported on Linux; Windows Server 2016+ includes Defender, and the extension can configure rather than install it.
